pages.title: Asymptotic Safety
pages.text: $(thing)Asymptotic Safety$()$(br2)Gravity's coupling, followed to ever shorter distances, may settle onto a fixed point instead of blowing up - and then general relativity is a complete quantum theory as it stands.
$(thing)Insight$(): 300$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Loop Quantum Gravity, Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Spin Network Node, 2 Causal Set Seed.
